page.running_head: Essendo per dire, weil zusagen ist, nachdem zusagen ist.

main_text.head: DECLINATIO VERBI PARLO, PARLARE, reden.
Indicat. mod. temp. praes.
Praeteritum imperfect.
main_text.l: Voi parlauate, jhr redtet, oder redetet, (loquebamini.)
main_text.head: Praeteritum perfect.
main_text.l: Io parlai, & ho parlato, ich hab geredt, (locutus sum.)
Tu parlasti, tu hai parlato, du haft geredt, (locutus es.)
Colui parlo, & ha parlato, er hat geredt, (locutus est.)

page.notes: Several words are damaged or faded in the scan; the Italian forms and some glosses in the conjugation table (notably "loquitur", "loquuntur", "parlauano") are read with doubt. The final line "Noi" is the start of the next page's section, cut at the foot. The Latin glosses in parentheses are as printed.
